calculation.description: For each tradable benchmark, remove the 60-day rolling beta exposure to the equal-weight benchmark return from the 40-day return, then scale by 40-day residual volatility and lag one completed session. Higher values indicate risk-adjusted idiosyncratic leadership.

validation.regime_notes: 20-day ICIR clears the benchmark gates (absolute IC >= 0.0070 and absolute ICIR >= 0.0840). Daily IC was 0.003898/ICIR 0.014162 and 10-day IC was 0.007564/ICIR 0.027312, so predictive strength is horizon-dependent. Annual 20-day aggregate was not separately printed; 2031 daily results were weak, requiring revalidation.
